examples.text: anāpatti, ādiyitvā paribhuñjati, kappo naṭṭho hoti, kappakat'okāso jiṇṇo hoti, kappakatena akappakataṃ saṃsibbitaṃ hoti, aggaḷe anuvāte paribhaṇḍe, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
kiṃ nu kho, bhante, orimaṃ tīraṃ, kiṃ pārimaṃ tīraṃ, ko majjhe saṃsīdo, ko thale ussādo, ko manussaggāho, ko amanussaggāho, ko āvaṭṭaggāho, ko antopūtibhāvo'ti?
tam'enaṃ mahā janakāyo saṅgamma samāgamma āyāceyya thomeyya pañjaliko anuparisakkeyya, osīda, bho sappitela, saṃsīda, bho sappitela, adho gaccha, bho sappitelā'ti.
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, sace tumhe'pi na orimaṃ tīraṃ upagacchatha, na pārimaṃ tīraṃ upagacchatha, na majjhe saṃsīdissatha, na thale ussīdissatha

61807.meaning2: sank down, lost heart, failed in

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, kiṃ nu kho, bhante, orimaṃ tīraṃ, kiṃ pārimaṃ tīraṃ, ko majjhe saṃsīdito, ko thale ussādo, ko manussaggāho, ko amanussaggāho, ko āvaṭṭaggāho, ko antopūtibhāvo'ti?

61809.commentary: (DNa) saṃsīdantī'ti samatalan'ti saññāya paṅkaṃ otiṇṇā viya anuppavisanti. saṃsīditvā visāraṃ pāpuṇantī'ti evaṃ paṅke viya saṃsīditvā visāraṃ aṅgamaṅgasaṃbhañjanaṃ pāpuṇanti. (DNt) saṃsīditvā'ti nimmujjitvā.

examples.text: idha kho pana te, vāseṭṭha, tevijjā brāhmaṇā āsīditvā saṃsīdanti, saṃsīditvā visāraṃ pāpuṇanti, sukkhataraṃ maññe taranti.
oropayitvā gihibyañjanāni, saṃsīnapatto yathā koviḷāro, chetvāna vīro gihibandhanāni, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

61812.synonym: asaṃkiliṭṭha, asecanaka, parisuddha, visada, vītaraja, suci, sucibhūta, sucīmant, suddha, suddhika

examples.text: tam'āhu sekhaṃ paṭipadaṃ, atho saṃsuddhacāriyaṃ, tam'āhu loke sambuddhaṃ, dhīraṃ paṭipad'antaguṃ.
upekkhāsatisaṃsuddhaṃ, dhammatakkapurejavaṃ, aññāvimokkhaṃ pabrūmi, avijjāya pabhedanaṃ.

61813.meaning1: of good birth; of pure lineage
61813.commentary: (MNa) saṃsuddhagahaṇiko'ti saṃsuddhā te mātu gahaṇī, saṃsuddhā te mātu kucchī'ti attho.

examples.text: khattiyo nāma ubhato sujāto hoti, mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko, yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakuṭṭho jātivādena.
tam'āhu sekhaṃ paṭipadaṃ, atho saṃsuddhacāriyaṃ, tam'āhu loke sambuddhaṃ, dhīraṃ paṭipad'antaguṃ.
tam'āhu sekhaṃ paṭipadaṃ, atho saṃsuddhacārinaṃ, tam'āhu loke sambuddhaṃ, dhīraṃ paṭipad'antaguṃ.
passāmi suddhaṃ paramaṃ arogaṃ, diṭṭhena saṃsuddhi narassa hoti, ev'ābhijānaṃ paraman'ti ñatvā, suddh'ānupassī'ti pacceti ñāṇaṃ.
catasso kho imā, sāriputta, yoniyo. katamā catasso? aṇḍajā yoni, jalābujā yoni, saṃsedajā yoni, opapātikā yoni.
katamā ca, sāriputta, saṃsedajā yoni? ye kho te, sāriputta, sattā pūtimacche vā jāyanti pūtikuṇape vā pūtikummāse vā candanikāye vā oḷigalle vā jāyanti, ayaṃ vuccati, sāriputta, saṃsedajā yoni.
catasso yoniyo, aṇḍajayoni, jalābujayoni, saṃsedajayoni, opapātikayoni.
ko c'āhāro asaddhammassavanassa? asappurisasaṃsevo'ti'ssa vacanīyaṃ
catubbipallāsavasaṃ adhiṭṭhitaṃ, gāmaṇḍalaṃ'va parinesi citta maṃ, nanu saṃyojanabandhanacchidaṃ, saṃsevase kāruṇikaṃ mahāmuniṃ.

61827.commentary: (THa) atha vā saṃsevitā upāsitā vuddhasīlino etenā'ti saṃsevitavuddhasīlī, tena.

examples.text: susukhumanipuṇ'atthadassinā, matikusalena nivātavuttinā, saṃsevitavuddhasīlinā, nibbānaṃ na hi tena dullabhan'ti.
pañhaṃ puṭṭho'pi, pañhaṃ kathessāmī'ti hanuṃ saṃsodheti, so itarena, idaṃ nāma kathessasī'ti vutto ñātabhāvaṃ ñatvā, na etaṃ, aññaṃ kathessāmī'ti vadati. evaṃ parikappe na saṇṭhāti nāma.
pañhaṃ kathessāmī'ti hanuṃ saṃsodhento'pi, tvaṃ imaṃ nāma kathessasī'ti vutte, āma, etaṃ'y'eva kathessāmī'ti vadati. evaṃ parikappe saṇṭhāti nāma.

61833.commentary: (PVa) utusaṃvaccharāni cā'ti vasanta-gimh'ādike bahū utū ca saṃvaccharāni ca, sabbattha accantasaṃyoge upayogavacanaṃ.

examples.text: dve vassānī'ti dve saṃvaccharāni. asikkhitasikkhā nāma sikkhā vā na dinnā hoti, dinnā vā sikkhā kupitā.
bahū māse ca pakkhe ca, utusaṃvaccharāni ca, mahādānaṃ pavattesi, aṅkuro dīgham'antaraṃ.

yaṃ kho pana, rājañña, mānussakaṃ vassasataṃ, devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ eso eko rattin'divo, tāya rattiyā tiṃsarattiyo māso, tena māsena dvādasamāsiyo saṃvaccharo, tena saṃvaccharena dibbaṃ vassasahassaṃ devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ.

tasmiṃ pana nagare anusaṃvaccharaṃ vivaṭanakkhattaṃ nāma hoti. tadā bahi anikkhamanakulāni'pi parivārena saddhiṃ gehā nikkhamitvā appaṭicchannena sarīrena padasā'va nadītīraṃ gacchanti

saṃvaṭṭamāne, bhikkhave, loke ābhassarā devā aggam'akkhāyanti. ābhassarānam'pi kho, bhikkhave, devānaṃ atth'eva aññathattaṃ atthi vipariṇāmo.

61841.meaning2: contraction and expansion; devolution and evolution

examples.text: satta vassāni mettaṃ cittaṃ bhāvesiṃ. satta vassāni mettaṃ cittaṃ bhāvetvā satta saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe na'y'imaṃ lokaṃ punāgamāsiṃ. saṃvaṭṭamāne sud'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, loke ābhassar'ūpago homi, vivaṭṭamāne loke suññaṃ brahmavimānaṃ upapajjāmi.

61846.synonym: parivaḍḍhati, pavaḍḍhati, pavaḍḍheti, phātikaroti, brūheti, rūhati, vaḍḍhati, vaḍḍhayati, vaddhati

61854.meaning2: having reared, having nourished, having brought up

61859.meaning1: approved; commended; praised; spoken highly of (by)

61862.meaning1: to be explained; to be commented on

61866.meaning2: having explained, having commented, having praised

examples.text: katamā ca sā, bhikkhave, majjhimā paṭipadā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati? ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo, seyyath'idaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
saṅkhārā ca h'idaṃ, bhikkhave, attā abhavissaṃsu, na'y'idaṃ saṅkhārā ābādhāya saṃvatteyyuṃ, labbhetha ca saṅkhāresu, evaṃ me saṅkhārā hontu, evaṃ me saṅkhārā mā ahesun'ti.

61872.commentary: (MNa) upacārasamādhiṃ vā appanāsamādhiṃ vā saṃvattayantī'ti samādhisaṃvattanikānī'ti vuccanti.

examples.text: pharusavāco hoti. yā sā vācā aṇḍakā kakkasā parakaṭukā par'ābhisajjanī kodhasāmantā asamādhisaṃvattanikā, tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti
bhikkhu yāni tāni sīlāni akhaṇḍāni acchiddāni asabalāni akammāsāni bhujissāni viññuppasatthāni aparāmaṭṭhāni samādhisaṃvattanikāni
hoti so, bhikkhave, samayo yaṃ ayaṃ loko saṃvaṭṭati. saṃvaṭṭamāne, bhikkhave, loke yebhuyyena sattā ābhassarasaṃvattanikā bhavanti.

yaṃ nu kho ahaṃ idaṃ vācāya kammaṃ akāsiṃ idaṃ me vacīkammaṃ attabyābādhāya'pi saṃvatti, parabyābādhāya'pi saṃvatti, ubhayabyābādhāya'pi saṃvatti, akusalaṃ idaṃ vacīkammaṃ dukkh'udrayaṃ dukkhavipākan'ti?

61879.meaning2: having made go on or continued

examples.text: evaṃ vimuttacitto kho, aggivessana, bhikkhu na kenaci saṃvadati, na kenaci vivadati, yañ'ca loke vuttaṃ tena voharati, aparāmasan'ti.

61882.commentary: (SNa) saṃvadamānā'ti sammā vadamānā, attano balassa suṭṭhu vaṇṇaṃ vadamānā'ti attho.

examples.text: bhikkhū'pi āyasmantaṃ vakkhanti sahadhammena, evaṃ saṃvaddhā hi tassa bhagavato parisā yadidaṃ aññam'aññavacanena aññam'aññavuṭṭhāpanenā'ti
anūpavādo anūpaghāto, pātimokkhe ca saṃvaro, mattaññutā ca bhattasmiṃ, pantañ'ca sayan'āsanaṃ, adhicitte ca āyogo, etaṃ buddhāna sāsanaṃ.
ehi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, sīlavā hohi, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharāhi ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī, samādāya sikkhassu sikkhāpadesū'ti
cakkhunā saṃvaro sādhu, sādhu sotena saṃvaro, ghānena saṃvaro sādhu, sādhu jivhāya saṃvaro.
savanti sabbadhi sotā, sotānaṃ kiṃ nivāraṇaṃ, sotānaṃ saṃvaraṃ brūhi, kena sotā pidhiyyare.
saḷ'eva phass'āyatanāni bhikkhavo, asaṃvuto yattha dukkhaṃ nigacchati, tesañ'ca ye saṃvaraṇaṃ avedisuṃ, saddhādutiyā viharant'ānavassutā.

61890.commentary: (DNa) saṃvaraṇan'ti saṃvaraṇaṃ nāma ajja nakkhattaṃ sundaraṃ, ajj'eva samaggā hotha, iti vo viyogo na bhavissatī'ti evaṃ samaggakaraṇaṃ. vivaraṇaṃ nāma sace viyujjitu'kām'attha, ajj'eva viyujjatha, iti vo puna saṃyogo na bhavissatī'ti evaṃ visaṃyogakaraṇaṃ.

examples.text: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ, āvāhanaṃ vivāhanaṃ saṃvaraṇaṃ vivaraṇaṃ saṃkiraṇaṃ vikiraṇaṃ subhagakaraṇaṃ dubbhagakaraṇaṃ viruddhagabbhakaraṇaṃ jivhānibandhanaṃ

61891.meaning2: for the sake of restraining oneself

examples.text: passatha, bhante, taṃ āpattiṃ. āma, āvuso, passāmi. āyatiṃ, bhante, saṃvareyyātha. sādhu suṭṭhu, āvuso, saṃvarissāmi.
tena vattabbo, passasī'ti. āma passāmī'ti. āyatiṃ saṃvareyyāsī'ti

61893.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of saṃvarattha
61893.meaning1: for the sake of restraint; for the purpose of control

examples.text: atha kho idaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ vussati saṃvar'atthaṃ pahān'atthaṃ virāg'atthaṃ nirodh'atthan'ti.

61894.meaning1: making an effort to control; striving for restraint

examples.text: yatv'ādhikaraṇam'enaṃ man'indriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati man'indriyaṃ, manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati. idaṃ vuccat'āvuso, saṃvarapadhānaṃ.

61895.meaning1: making an effort to control; striving for restraint

examples.text: saṃvarappadhānaṃ, pahānappadhānaṃ, bhāvanāppadhānaṃ, anurakkhaṇāppadhānaṃ. katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, saṃvarappadhānaṃ? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti n'ānubyañjanaggāhī.

navame kilesānaṃ saṃvar'atthāya pavesanadvāraṃ pidahan'atthāya padhānaṃ saṃvarappadhānaṃ, pajahan'atthāya padhānaṃ pahānappadhānaṃ, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ brūhan'atthāya vaḍḍhan'atthāya padhānaṃ bhāvanāppadhānaṃ, tesaṃ'y'eva anurakkhaṇ'atthāya padhānaṃ anurakkhaṇāppadhānaṃ.

61898.meaning1: concerning removal by restraint and removal by abandoning

61899.meaning1: restrain oneself; holds oneself back; exercises restraint

examples.text: dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa, kiñ'c'āpi tathārūpiṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati, yathārūpāya āpattiyā vuṭṭhānaṃ paññāyati, atha kho naṃ khippam'eva satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārīsu deseti vivarati uttānīkaroti, desetvā vivaritvā uttānīkatvā āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjatha, rakkhatha cakkhu'ndriyaṃ, cakkhu'ndriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjatha.
